items.docs: Get a list of available dimensions and their distinct values for a test case. This helps in understanding what dimensional breakdowns are available for filtering.

params.name: fqn
params.description: Fully qualified name of the test case

params.name: startTs
params.description: Start timestamp to list dimensional results from

params.name: endTs
params.description: End timestamp to list dimensional results to

params.name: dimensionName
params.description: Filter by dimension name (e.g., 'column' to get all column dimension results)

items.docs: Get a list of dimensional results for a specific test case. Results can be filtered by time range and specific dimension values. Use `startTs` and `endTs` to filter results within a time range. Use `dimensionalityKey` to filter results for a specific dimension value combination. Use `dimensionName` to filter results for all values of a specific dimension (e.g., 'column' to get all column dimension results).
